source_caption:
📺 Ghosts (2021–Present)

Ghosts follows Samantha and Jay Arondekar, a young married couple who inherit a beautiful but rundown country estate and decide to transform it into a charming bed-and-breakfast. Their plans take an unexpected turn when Samantha suffers a near-death experience and suddenly gains the ability to see and communicate with the ghosts haunting their new home. The spirits come from different historical periods, including a Viking warrior, a Revolutionary War officer, a 1920s jazz singer, and a free-spirited hippie, each bringing their own hilarious personalities and unfinished business. While Jay cannot see the ghosts, Samantha must balance her marriage, business ambitions, and the demands of her unusual supernatural roommates. Starring Rose McIver and Utkarsh Ambudkar, the series delivers laugh-out-loud comedy, heartwarming friendships, unexpected romance, and touching moments while exploring love, family, acceptance, and the importance of human connection.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Supernatural • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Developers: Joe Port & Joe Wiseman

📚 Based On: The British television series Ghosts (2019).

📺 Where to Watch: CBS and Paramount+ in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Ghosts is a British sitcom broadcast on BBC One from 15 April 2019 to 25 December 2023 and spanned five series and 34 episodes, including specials. It follows a group of ghosts from different historical periods haunting a country house while sharing the house with its new living occupants, a married couple played by Charlotte Ritchie and Kiell Smith-Bynoe. It was written and performed by the collective group Them There, who had previously worked together on productions including Horrible Histories and Yonderland.
